purpose.domain_detail: Customer master file maintenance (add, change, delete) via CICS online transaction; likely part of an inventory/order management system given XCTL to INVMENU
purpose.summary: CUSTMNT2 is a CICS online program that handles customer record maintenance (add, change, delete) against a VSAM CUSTMAS file. It uses two BMS maps (MNTMAP1 for key entry, MNTMAP2 for customer data entry) and manages context via a COMMAREA across pseudo-conversational transactions identified as MNT2.

notable_features: EXEC CICS (BMS maps, XCTL, READ, SEND, RETURN with COMMAREA)
Pseudo-conversational design using COMMAREA and context flags
DFHAID PF key handling (PF3, PF12, CLEAR, ENTER, PA1-PA3)
BMS map attribute manipulation (ATTR-REVERSE, ATTR-PROT, ATTR-NO-HIGHLIGHT)
COPY books: CUSTMAS, MNTSET2, DFHAID, ATTR, ERRPARM
INSPECT ... REPLACING ALL '_' BY SPACE for field handling
88-level condition names for send flags and context flags
